verdict.rationale: Snowflake's developer docs list official JDBC and ODBC drivers (plus Python, Go and Node.js), which gives dashboards a standard connection path without custom glue. The docs also reference 'applications and tools that you can use to access Snowflake', but no specific BI-tool integration (named partner connectors or setup guides) is evidenced. missing for 10: documented integrations with named BI tools, in-depth driver documentation beyond a single listing line, independent or hands-on corroboration of a BI dashboard connecting via JDBC/ODBC.
